# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

SURGICEL™ Powder Absorbable Hemostat Essential Product Information

INDICATIONS

SURGICEL™ Powder (oxidized regenerated cellulose) is used adjunctively in surgical procedures to
assist in the control of capillary, venous, and small arterial hemorrhage when ligation or other
conventional methods of control are impractical or ineffective. SURGICEL Powder can also be applied

The SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator is intended for use in delivering SURGICEL Powder Absorbable
Hemostat to bleeding surgical sites through a 5 mm or larger trocar.

CONTRAINDICATIONS
* Do not inject or place SURGICEL Powder into an open blood vessel. Do not use to treat bleeding
  from large defects in arteries or veins.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used to control hemorrhage from large arteries or veins. The
  SURGICEL Powder and the SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator devices was not designed for intraluminal
  procedures.
* When SURGICEL Powder is used to help achieve hemostasis in, around, or in proximity to foramina in
  bone, areas of bony confine, the spinal cord, or the optic nerve and chiasm, and in proximity to
  tubular structures that could become constricted by swelling, it must always be removed after
  hemostasis is achieved since it will swell and could exert unwanted pressure. Unlike other
  SURGICEL products, SURGICEL Powder cannot be removed from blood clots and complete removal of the
  device application may disrupt the lot and increase the risk of re-bleeding.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used for implantation in bone defects, such as fractures, since
  there is a possibility of interference with callus formation and a theoretical chance of cyst
  formation.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used on non-hemorrhagic serous oozing surfaces, since body fluids
  other than whole blood, such as serum, do not react with SURGICEL Powder to produce satisfactory
  hemostatic effect.
* SURGICEL Powder is an absorbable hemostat and should not be used as an adhesion prevention
  product.


WARNINGS
* SURGICEL Powder is not intended for use on dry (non-bleeding) surfaces or for prevention of
  bleeding.
* SURGICEL Powder and SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator devices are supplied sterile and as the
  material is not compatible with autoclaving or ethylene oxide sterilization, SURGICEL Powder and
  SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator should not be resterilized.
* SURGICEL Powder is not intended as a substitute for careful surgery and the proper use of sutures
  and ligatures.
* Closing with SURGICEL Powder in a contaminated wound without drainage may lead to complications
  and should be avoided.
* The hemostatic effect of SURGICEL Powder is greater when it is applied dry; therefore, it should
  not be moistened with water or saline prior to application.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be impregnated with anti-infective agents or with other materials such

## Redefining surgical outcomes

Surgical complications, including infections, bleeding, and wound reopening, impact millions
globally. Without standard definitions and measures to classify surgical site complications,
addressing these challenges is complex. That’s why we’re collaborating with global experts to
advancing standards for safer surgery.

SURGICEL™ Powder Absorbable Hemostat Essential Product Information

INDICATIONS

SURGICEL™ Powder (oxidized regenerated cellulose) is used adjunctively in surgical procedures to
assist in the control of capillary, venous, and small arterial hemorrhage when ligation or other
conventional methods of control are impractical or ineffective. SURGICEL Powder can also be applied
in laparoscopic or other endoscopic procedures when used with the SURGICEL™ Endoscopic Applicator.

The SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator is intended for use in delivering SURGICEL Powder Absorbable
Hemostat to bleeding surgical sites through a 5 mm or larger trocar.

CONTRAINDICATIONS
* Do not inject or place SURGICEL Powder into an open blood vessel. Do not use to treat bleeding
  from large defects in arteries or veins.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used to control hemorrhage from large arteries or veins. The
  SURGICEL Powder and the SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator devices was not designed for intraluminal
  procedures.
* When SURGICEL Powder is used to help achieve hemostasis in, around, or in proximity to foramina in
  bone, areas of bony confine, the spinal cord, or the optic nerve and chiasm, and in proximity to
  tubular structures that could become constricted by swelling, it must always be removed after
  hemostasis is achieved since it will swell and could exert unwanted pressure. Unlike other
  SURGICEL products, SURGICEL Powder cannot be removed from blood clots and complete removal of the
  device application may disrupt the lot and increase the risk of re-bleeding.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used for implantation in bone defects, such as fractures, since
  there is a possibility of interference with callus formation and a theoretical chance of cyst
  formation.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used on non-hemorrhagic serous oozing surfaces, since body fluids
  other than whole blood, such as serum, do not react with SURGICEL Powder to produce satisfactory
  hemostatic effect.
* SURGICEL Powder is an absorbable hemostat and should not be used as an adhesion prevention
  product.


WARNINGS
* SURGICEL Powder is not intended for use on dry (non-bleeding) surfaces or for prevention of
  bleeding.
* SURGICEL Powder and SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator devices are supplied sterile and as the
  material is not compatible with autoclaving or ethylene oxide sterilization, SURGICEL Powder and
  SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator should not be resterilized.
* SURGICEL Powder is not intended as a substitute for careful surgery and the proper use of sutures
  and ligatures.
* Closing with SURGICEL Powder in a contaminated wound without drainage may lead to complications
  and should be avoided.
* The hemostatic effect of SURGICEL Powder is greater when it is applied dry; therefore, it should
  not be moistened with water or saline prior to application.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be impregnated with anti-infective agents or with other materials such

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated

# Become a Rural Entrepreneur
#  

By becoming a Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE), the user will be able to work on Digital Seva Portal
and will be able to deliver various government and non-government services.

Become a part of the Digital India programme, and work as a Village Level Enterprenuer, apply for a
CSC ID

[Get Started][11]

### Do you have any question?

VLE registration is a simple and easy process to register as a VLE in the CSC ecosystem.
Registration is free of cost. Just fill your details and join the CSC network.
* If you have questions, please feel free to ask.
* [Register Now][12]
* [FAQs][13]

Your Name
Enter Your Email
Your Question
[Ask Question][14]

## What VLE's Says

** Common Services Center (CSC) had not only helped rural citizens to avail digital services but
helped me in generating income for my family thereby gaining respect and recognition in society. **

#### VARAVOOR, KERALA

##### [#LivingMyLifeWithCSC][15]

** Export tempor illum tamen malis malis eram quae irure esse labore quem cillum quid cillum eram
malis quorum velit fore eram velit sunt aliqua noster fugiat irure amet legam anim culpa. **

### SHALINI

#### MATHUR, KERALA

##### [#LivingMyLifeWithCSC][16]

** It's the time of Digital India and I'm really happy that I'm also a part of it now. Working with
CSC has given me a new way of life and I'm optimistic that I can do a lot more in life. **

### CRISTEEB

#### VARAVOOR, KERALA

##### [#LivingMyLifeWithCSC][17]

** CSC has given a new identity, not just for me, but for my employees as well. I have learned a lot
of new things with the help of CSC and I'm happy that I get to share my knowledge with everyone. **

### CHANDRU

#### BANGALORE, KARNATAKA

##### [#LivingMyLifeWithCSC][18]

** CSCs are the pillars of digitally driven India. It gives an opportunity to common people to start
a business and establish themselves. I'm happy to be a part of it. **

### GURUNATHAN

#### VARAVALLI, TAMIL NADU

##### [#LivingMyLifeWithCSC][19]

** I want to help my village. I want to help my people. Keeping that in mind, I started a CSC a few
years back. I'm really happy to serve my people and thankful to everyone for the support. **

manner and sale of used/refurbished Endoscopy equipment. Assuring the most competative cost.
During the 22 years, we have assembled a winning team of professionals with over a century of
combined experience. Our team seeks to understand our clients concerns, so that we can provide
solutions.
Thorough inspection of your inventory of endoscopes by our trained professionals, typically lead to
a better understanding of preventive maintenance practices. Working closely with our clients, our
goal is to keep repair costs down, while maintaining the best repair quality. Our sales staff will
work with you to determine programs best suited to your individual needs.
 

Thank you for allowing us to provide you and your facility(s) this information. Please contact us
for any questions.

## The history and evolution of Medi-Globe

History

### 1990

Medi-Globe Corporation was established in the USA as a medical device sales and distribution company

### 1996

Focus on minimally-invasive surgery medical devices via the acquisition of GIP Medizintechnik GmbH
(Germany)

### 1998

Acquisition of Endo-Flex GmbH (Germany)

### 2000

Acquisition of Asid Bonz GmbH (Germany) and Asept InMed SAS (France) to strengthen the direct
presence in Western Europe

### 2001

Acquisition of UroVision GmbH (Germany). Along with UroVision the firm acquired a Czech Republic
manufacturing facility, subsequently renamed as Medi-Globe s.r.o

### 2001

Transformation of Medi-Globe s.r.o. to the group’s primary manufacturing facility for all
gastroenterology and urology companies (Medi-Globe, Endo-Flex, Urovision)

### 2002

Acquisition of Endo-Technik GmbH (Germany) and UROTECH GmbH (Germany).
Renaming of GIP Medizin Technik to Medi-Globe GmbH

### 2007

Acquisition of Tüshaus GmbH (Germany) and integration into Asid Bonz GmbH.

### 2016

Medi-Globe Group is acquired by Duke Street to fund further growth and innovation

### 2019

Medi-Globe Group finds new partner for Endo-Technik

### 2022

Medi-Globe Group divests ASID BONZ to focus on their core business

### 2022

Medi-Globe-Group is aquired by DCC plc and is now part of the DCC Healthcare division

### 2025

Acquisition of DCC Medical Division (Medi-Globe) – establishing Vital Healthcare as a global MedTech
company

## Quality

##### We take our responsibility for developing, manufacturing and marketing instruments for the
##### benefit of patients seriously. In doing so, we strive to sustain and measurably improve the
##### quality and performance of our products, services, and processes.

[More information][29]

##### Our Quality Management (QM) monitors compliance with relevant national, European and
##### international standards and regulations for the development, manufacture and placing on the
##### market of our instruments. In addition, our QM department continuously monitors standardized
##### workflows and processes in all departments and corporate production sites to ensure, among
##### other things, the highest level of product quality.
##### Based on user feedback and market observations of our sales structures, QM assesses the
##### necessary measures to optimize products and processes.
##### Medi-Globe routinely conducts audits at our suppliers’ facilities to ensure that raw materials
##### and components are always delivered and manufactured to the agreed specifications.
##### Medi-Globe is currently taking the necessary measures to meet the requirements of the upcoming
##### MDR.

## Certificates, product registrations and import licenses

##### In addition to being ISO 13485:2016 certified, all our products bear the CE mark. Furthermore,
##### we operate in full compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and all requirements of
##### international health systems such as, but not limited to, the US Food & Drug Administration
##### (FDA), the Canadian Medical Device Regulations (CMDR), and the Japanese Pharmaceutical Affairs
##### Law (JPAL).

## The history and evolution of Medi-Globe

History

### 1990

Medi-Globe Corporation was established in the USA as a medical device sales and distribution company

### 1996

Focus on minimally-invasive surgery medical devices via the acquisition of GIP Medizintechnik GmbH
(Germany)

### 1998

Acquisition of Endo-Flex GmbH (Germany)

### 2000

Acquisition of Asid Bonz GmbH (Germany) and Asept InMed SAS (France) to strengthen the direct
presence in Western Europe

### 2001

Acquisition of UroVision GmbH (Germany). Along with UroVision the firm acquired a Czech Republic
manufacturing facility, subsequently renamed as Medi-Globe s.r.o

### 2001

Transformation of Medi-Globe s.r.o. to the group’s primary manufacturing facility for all
gastroenterology and urology companies (Medi-Globe, Endo-Flex, Urovision)

### 2002

Acquisition of Endo-Technik GmbH (Germany) and UROTECH GmbH (Germany).
Renaming of GIP Medizin Technik to Medi-Globe GmbH

### 2007

Acquisition of Tüshaus GmbH (Germany) and integration into Asid Bonz GmbH.

### 2016

Medi-Globe Group is acquired by Duke Street to fund further growth and innovation

### 2019

Medi-Globe Group finds new partner for Endo-Technik

### 2022

Medi-Globe Group divests ASID BONZ to focus on their core business

### 2022

Medi-Globe-Group is aquired by DCC plc and is now part of the DCC Healthcare division

### 2025

Acquisition of DCC Medical Division (Medi-Globe) – establishing Vital Healthcare as a global MedTech
company

## Quality

##### We take our responsibility for developing, manufacturing and marketing instruments for the
##### benefit of patients seriously. In doing so, we strive to sustain and measurably improve the
##### quality and performance of our products, services, and processes.

[More information][29]

##### Our Quality Management (QM) monitors compliance with relevant national, European and
##### international standards and regulations for the development, manufacture and placing on the
##### market of our instruments. In addition, our QM department continuously monitors standardized
##### workflows and processes in all departments and corporate production sites to ensure, among
##### other things, the highest level of product quality.
##### Based on user feedback and market observations of our sales structures, QM assesses the
##### necessary measures to optimize products and processes.
##### Medi-Globe routinely conducts audits at our suppliers’ facilities to ensure that raw materials
##### and components are always delivered and manufactured to the agreed specifications.
##### Medi-Globe is currently taking the necessary measures to meet the requirements of the upcoming
##### MDR.

## Certificates, product registrations and import licenses

##### In addition to being ISO 13485:2016 certified, all our products bear the CE mark. Furthermore,

##### international health systems such as, but not limited to, the US Food & Drug Administration
##### (FDA), the Canadian Medical Device Regulations (CMDR), and the Japanese Pharmaceutical Affairs

Standardized endoscopy software with complete steps, higher detection, and zero reporting time 

[Get a Demo][8]

## Turning Standards Into Action

Everyone agrees that standardization helps **reduce interval cancers and variability**—yet applying
dozens of steps and indicators from memory during real procedures is nearly impossible. 



Medical Pilot transforms **ESGE quality standards** into a **clear, guided workflow that drives the
procedure,** not the paperwork. 



**It is the first platform that brings medical quality standards into the room and effectively
guides the procedure in real time.**

## The workflow engine for modern endoscopy

[A male doctor in a white coat holding an endoscope in a medical examination room.]

#### High-Quality Exams

Visually guided steps and mandatory landmarks make every procedure more complete—without adding
extra time. 

#### Zero Reporting Time

Reports generate instantly at scope withdrawal, saving 6–10 minutes per case and enabling 20–25%
more patients per day.

#### Complete Documentation

Mandatory photo checkpoints and built-in classifications ensure precise, audit-ready records every
time. 

#### Consistent Quality

Standardized workflows reduce variability and ensure predictable quality across clinicians. 

#### Better Detection

On-screen metrics and alerts support safer, more consistent care. Live quality indicators ensure
adherence to clinical guidelines during procedures.

#### Training Mode

New clinicians learn the correct, standardized workflow from day one, rather than individual
habits—improving alignment and speeding up onboarding. 

## Zero typing. Zero guesswork. Zero variation.

See how Medical Pilot works inside a digestive endoscopy room.


The platform connects directly to the endoscope and provides an** intuitive, dropdown-based
interface **where every step follows standardized workflows.
With visual guidance, real-time metrics, and instant photo & video documentation, **complex
standards become effortless**.
Multi-language interface included.
And the moment the scope comes out, the **full medical report is ready.**

## Beyond the Procedure: A Complete Ecosystem

[Two healthcare professionals in blue scrubs discussing patient care in a hospital room.]

#### Patient File—Integrated Document Management

A secure, cloud-based file that stores all medical documents and images.
Patients can upload their records, and the MyMedicalPilot app streamlines communication and
scheduling. 

#### Patient Scheduling & Workflow

Smart scheduling with full patient status tracking, secure cloud access, and automated SMS/email
reminders for seamless coordination.

#### Custom Medical Procedure Editor

A flexible medical workflow editor for consultations, ultrasound, and non-standardized endoscopy
that allows photo capture, secure cloud storage, and customizable templates, 

#### Dynamic Procedure Costing

Automatically calculates the real cost of each procedure—team, collaborators, and resources—for
advanced financial management. 

#### Inventory & Consumables Management

Barcode-based tracking with real-time stock updates and fast scanner integration for precise,
automated inventory control.

#### Analytics & Quality Dashboard

 Real-time insights into performance, quality indicators, case distribution, and trends—supporting
audits, accreditation, and management decisions 

#### Integrations (EHR / HIS)

Seamless connectivity with existing hospital systems, ensuring smooth data flow and minimizing
duplicate work. 

## It helps me reduce the time needed for digestive endoscopy. I even started calling patients in
## earlier because I was finishing procedures faster. We’ll definitely be able to shorten endoscopy
## times, allowing us to schedule more patients within the same timeframe.

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is Medical Pilot priced?

We provide **flexible plans tailored to clinics of all sizes**—from individual gastroenterologists
to large teaching hospitals. Pricing is subscription-based and aligned with usage, number of
clinicians, and the value delivered. To receive the exact pricing for your clinic, simply request a
custom quote or book a [DEMO.][9]

How is Medical Pilot installed, and how does it work?

Medical Pilot is a cloud-based platform that requires no complex installation. **It connects
directly to your endoscopy tower through a simple plug-and-play setup and runs on any standard
workstation or tablet.** We help you with this process, no worries. Once activated, it guides the
clinician step-by-step through the procedure, displays real-time quality metrics, captures photos
automatically, and generates the final report the moment the procedure ends. 

How is Medical Pilot’s standardization different from other endoscopy software?

Most endoscopy software focuses on documentation after the procedure. Medical Pilot changes the
paradigm by **guiding the procedure itself**. It transforms complex standards into a live, visual
workflow (drop-down lists) reduces variability between clinicians, and ensures consistent quality
from start to finish. Instead of documenting what happened,** Medical Pilot helps ensure everything
happens the right way — in real time .**

Does Medical Pilot integrate with our existing HIS or EHR?

 **Medical Pilot integrates seamlessly with existing HIS and EHR systems via secure APIs**, ensuring
smooth data flow without disrupting current workflows.
**For clinics and practices that do not have an HIS or EHR, Medical Pilot provides its own
integrated modules**—including patient scheduling, medical file management, and complete
documentation workflows—offering a fully functional digital ecosystem .

How does Medical Pilot handle integrations and data security?

Medical Pilot integrates with your existing HIS or EHR through secure APIs, and for clinics without
these systems, we provide our own modules for scheduling, documentation, and patient management.
The platform is **ISO 27001** and **ISO 9001** certified, fully GDPR compliant, and ensures
encrypted, role-based, medical-grade data protection.

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is Medical Pilot priced?

We provide **flexible plans tailored to clinics of all sizes**—from individual gastroenterologists
to large teaching hospitals. Pricing is subscription-based and aligned with usage, number of
clinicians, and the value delivered. To receive the exact pricing for your clinic, simply request a
custom quote or book a [DEMO.][9]

How is Medical Pilot installed, and how does it work?

Medical Pilot is a cloud-based platform that requires no complex installation. **It connects
directly to your endoscopy tower through a simple plug-and-play setup and runs on any standard
workstation or tablet.** We help you with this process, no worries. Once activated, it guides the
clinician step-by-step through the procedure, displays real-time quality metrics, captures photos
automatically, and generates the final report the moment the procedure ends. 

How is Medical Pilot’s standardization different from other endoscopy software?

Most endoscopy software focuses on documentation after the procedure. Medical Pilot changes the
paradigm by **guiding the procedure itself**. It transforms complex standards into a live, visual
workflow (drop-down lists) reduces variability between clinicians, and ensures consistent quality
from start to finish. Instead of documenting what happened,** Medical Pilot helps ensure everything
happens the right way — in real time .**

Does Medical Pilot integrate with our existing HIS or EHR?

 **Medical Pilot integrates seamlessly with existing HIS and EHR systems via secure APIs**, ensuring
smooth data flow without disrupting current workflows.
**For clinics and practices that do not have an HIS or EHR, Medical Pilot provides its own
integrated modules**—including patient scheduling, medical file management, and complete
documentation workflows—offering a fully functional digital ecosystem .

How does Medical Pilot handle integrations and data security?

Medical Pilot integrates with your existing HIS or EHR through secure APIs, and for clinics without
these systems, we provide our own modules for scheduling, documentation, and patient management.
The platform is **ISO 27001** and **ISO 9001** certified, fully GDPR compliant, and ensures
encrypted, role-based, medical-grade data protection.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,

„Through intelligent and easy-to-learn access techniques based on our unintech concept, complex
procedures in endoscopic spine surgery are **simplified, surgical workflows are optimized** and both
**patient comfort** and **surgical precision** are sustainably enhanced.“

Dr. Erik Traupe

CMO Unintech GmbH

## The unintech concept

With our unintech concept, we set new standards in surgical techniques. Our approach builds upon the
Open-Surgery Concept: the precision of endoscopy and the experience of open surgery.

unintech techniques are characterized by
* **Tube-in-Tube-Technique**, based on and following open-surgery techniques.
* **Easy identification of anatomical landmarks** for better orientation.
* **Seamless integration** of prior open surgery experience with unintech endoscopic techniques.
* **Transforaminal foraminotomy and interlaminar fenestration** performed under endoscopic
  visualization and guidance.

[ Discover the unintech concept ][56]

### Why should you learn the unintech concept?

Your benefits

Less radiation
exposure

Minimizing intraoperative radiation helps protect both patients and surgical staff, contributing to
a safer working and treatment environment.

Less step
learning curve

The technique is designed to be intuitive, enabling surgeons to gain competence quickly and perform
with confidence in less time.

Less traumatic
for patients

By avoiding major incisions, this approach lowers postoperative pain and supports quicker return to
daily activities.

Less surgery time benefits all involved

Faster procedures lead to greater efficiency, reduced anesthesia duration, and an overall
improvement in patient recovery conditions.

Ready to get the most out of endoscopic spine surgery?

Discover the unintech method and learn how to effectively use our systems and devices in our
training courses. Gain hands-on experience and enhance your skills in endoscopic spine surgery with
expert guidance.

[ Discover our courses ][57]

## Product Overview

Our recommendations

### EndoSurg Plus
* Interlaminar
* Transforaminal

### EndoSurg Plus

The EndoSurg Plus System is unintech‘s most commonly used system for full-endoscopic spinal
decompression. It can be used transforaminal as well as interlaminar on thoracic and lumbar spine.
[ More information ][60]

### EndoSurg Standard
* Transforaminal

### EndoSurg Standard

The EndoSurg Standard System is unintech‘s transforaminal system for full-endoscopic spinal
decompression.
[ More information ][61]

### EndoSurg Max
* Interlaminar

### EndoSurg Max

The EndoSurg Max System is unintech‘s mostly commonly used full-endoscopic system for posterior
decompression at cervical and lumbar spine. With the instrument set EndoPLIF the EndoSurg Max system
is used for preparation the disc space for posterior lumbar interbody fusion.
[ More information ][62]

### EndoTLIF

### EndoTLIF

EndoTLIF instrument set is a supplement to the EndoSurg Plus system. It is designed and developed
for endoscopic transforaminal lumbar interbody fusion. The set contains all instruments for disc
space preparation.
[ More information ][63]

### EndoPLIF

### EndoPLIF

EndoPLIF instrument set is a supplement to the EndoSurg Max system. It is designed and developed for
endoscopic posterior lumbar interbody fusion. The set contains all instruments for disc space
preparation.
[ More information ][64]

unintech techniques are characterized by

### EndoSurg Max

The EndoSurg Max System is unintech‘s mostly commonly used full-endoscopic system for posterior
decompression at cervical and lumbar spine. With the instrument set EndoPLIF the EndoSurg Max system
is used for preparation the disc space for posterior lumbar interbody fusion.

EndoTLIF instrument set is a supplement to the EndoSurg Plus system. It is designed and developed
for endoscopic transforaminal lumbar interbody fusion. The set contains all instruments for disc
space preparation.

### EndoPLIF

EndoPLIF instrument set is a supplement to the EndoSurg Max system. It is designed and developed for
endoscopic posterior lumbar interbody fusion. The set contains all instruments for disc space
preparation.

# G2C SERVICE

[negp_img]

G2C expresses the relationship between the Government organizations for public administration and
the citizens of the country. All the Government services and information is made available to the
public on account of providing for the nation’s welfare. It takes into account all the transactions
that take place between the two parties.

The CSC offers multiple Government to Citizen services, that are currently available on the
e-District portal. It is to be noted that delivery of Government services is mandatory for the CSCs
that presently provides 159 services across 20 departments. The services available are from the
following list of departments:
* Revenue
* [csc service] Medical & Health
* [csc service] Social Welfare
* [csc service] Women Welfare & Child Development
* [csc service] Food Safety & Drug Administration
* Handicap Welfare
* [csc service] Panchayati Raj
* [csc service] Urban Development
* Employment
* [csc service] Labour Board (BOC)
* [csc service] Food & Civil Supplies
* [csc service] Commercial Tax
* [csc service] Agriculture
* [csc service] Lok Shikayat (CM Office)
* Department of Religious Affairs
* [csc service] Power
* [csc service] Entertainment Tax
* Home Department
* [csc service] Technical Education Department

DOWNLOAD G2C SERVICE LIST:      [ Click Here ][21]

# B2C Service

B2C refers to the direct relationship of the businesses with the customers. It takes into account
the transactions that take place between the business and the customer, who is the end user of the
product or service.

The CSC offers a multitude of Business to Customer services ranging in the areas of Education, Life
and General Insurance, Financial Services, Rail Ticket Booking, PAN, DTH Booking and Mobile
Recharge, Health, Agriculture, Commercial, Retail, etc. To that effect, the list of possible service
areas is, as follows:

⚡️ Blazing fast terminal file manager written in Rust, based on async I/O.

All I/O operations are asynchronous, CPU tasks are spread across multiple threads, making the most

### Built-in Support for Multiple Image Protocols

Also integrated with Überzug++, covering almost all terminals.

### Built-in Code Highlighting and Image Encoding

Combined with the pre-caching mechanism, greatly accelerates image and normal file loading.

# Yazi

⚡️ Blazing fast terminal file manager written in Rust, based on async I/O.

[Get Started 🚀][10]

### Full Asynchronous Support

All I/O operations are asynchronous, CPU tasks are spread across multiple threads, making the most
of available resources.

### Powerful Async Task Scheduling and Management

Provides real-time progress updates, task cancellation, and internal task priority assignment.

### Built-in Support for Multiple Image Protocols

Also integrated with Überzug++, covering almost all terminals.

### Built-in Code Highlighting and Image Encoding

Combined with the pre-caching mechanism, greatly accelerates image and normal file loading.
